name: port_developers_funding_month
description: Section 12 test 11 (PD8): funding at 50 % (line 1 full 700, current 350), one small airport (capacity 10000). The airport's trips are its funded share of the jobs (own 5000 / subnetwork 5000 x jobs), so 4000 jobs give 4000 trips. The month's usage ratio uses the plain capacity (the internal PortUsageValues, no funding scaling): 4000 / 10000 = 0.4. The public query (slot 12) scales the cap: trunc(float(10000) / 700 x 350) = 5000, usage min(4000, 5000) = 4000. With 6000 trips the month's ratio is 0.6 and the query gives 5000, 5000.
